name: google-drive
description: Use connected Google Drive as the single entrypoint for Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides work. Use when the user wants to find, fetch, organize, share, export, copy, or delete Drive files, or summarize and edit Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides through one unified Google Drive plugin.

findings.excerpt: - Before any export or download, read or reuse Drive metadata so the MIME type is known. Use `export_file` only for native Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides files
- If the thumbnail response only exposes a thumbnail URL or `contentUrl`, curl the rendered image to a local PNG, for example `curl -L "$contentUrl" -o /tmp/sli
- If the thumbnail response only provides a thumbnail URL or `contentUrl`, save the rendered image locally with `curl -L "$contentUrl" -o /tmp/slides-thumb-<sli
